nodes.summary: For a real number $\ell$, the edge list of a cube of side $\ell$ consists of $12$ edges, each of length $\ell$ with dihedral angle $\pi / 2$.
nodes.title: Edge list of a cube

nodes.summary: The Dehn group is the tensor product $\mathbb{R} \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} (\mathbb{R} / 2\pi\mathbb{Z})$ of abelian groups; it is the target of the Dehn invariant.
nodes.title: Dehn group

nodes.summary: For lists of edges $L_1$ and $L_2$, the Dehn invariant of the concatenation of $L_1$ and $L_2$ is the sum of the Dehn invariants of $L_1$ and $L_2$.
nodes.title: Additivity of the Dehn invariant under concatenation

nodes.summary: Let $e$ be an edge of length $\ell$ and dihedral angle $\theta$, and let $L$ be a list of edges. Then the Dehn invariant of the list obtained by putting $e$ in front of $L$ equals $\ell \otimes \theta$ plus the Dehn invariant of $L$, where $\theta$ is taken modulo $2\pi$.
nodes.title: The Dehn invariant splits off the first edge

nodes.summary: For every real number $\ell$, the edge list of a cube of side $\ell$ (twelve edges of length $\ell$, each with dihedral angle $\pi / 2$) has Dehn invariant $0$.
nodes.title: The Dehn invariant of the cube is zero

nodes.summary: Suppose that $\arccos(1/3) / \pi$ is irrational. Then for all real numbers $\ell$ and $\ell'$ with $\ell' \ne 0$, the edge list of a cube of side $\ell$ and the edge list of a regular tetrahedron of side $\ell'$ have different Dehn invariants.
nodes.title: Conditionally, the cube and the regular tetrahedron have different Dehn invariants

nodes.summary: The empty list of edges has Dehn invariant $0$.
nodes.title: Dehn invariant of the empty edge list

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and an edge of length $\ell$ and dihedral angle $\theta$, the Dehn invariant of the list consisting of $n$ copies of that edge is $n \cdot (\ell \otimes \theta)$ in the Dehn group, where $\theta$ is taken modulo $2\pi$.
nodes.title: Dehn invariant of a repeated edge

nodes.summary: Suppose that $\arccos(1/3) / \pi$ is irrational. Then for every nonzero real number $\ell$, the edge list of a regular tetrahedron of side $\ell$ (six edges of length $\ell$, each with dihedral angle $\arccos(1/3)$) has nonzero Dehn invariant.
nodes.title: Nonzero Dehn invariant of the regular tetrahedron, conditional on irrationality

nodes.summary: The Dehn invariant of a list of edges is the sum, over the edges, of $\ell \otimes \theta$ in the Dehn group, where $\ell$ is the length of the edge and $\theta$ its dihedral angle taken modulo $2\pi$.
nodes.title: Dehn invariant

nodes.summary: An edge, as recorded for the Dehn invariant, is a pair of real numbers: its length and its dihedral angle in radians. No positivity or range condition is imposed on either.
nodes.title: Edge of a polyhedron

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a real number such that $\alpha / \pi$ is irrational. Then there is a $\mathbb{Q}$-linear map $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ with $f(\pi) = 0$ and $f(\alpha) \neq 0$.
nodes.title: A $\mathbb{Q}$-linear functional separating $\alpha$ from $\pi$

nodes.summary: The real number $\arccos(1/3)$, the dihedral angle of a regular tetrahedron in radians.
nodes.title: Dihedral angle of the regular tetrahedron

nodes.summary: For a real number $\ell$, the edge list of a regular tetrahedron with edge length $\ell$ is the list of $6$ edges, each of length $\ell$ and dihedral angle $\arccos(1/3)$.
nodes.title: Edge list of the regular tetrahedron

nodes.summary: Let $\ell$ and $\alpha$ be real numbers with $\ell \neq 0$ and $\alpha / \pi$ irrational. Then the pure tensor $\ell \otimes [\alpha]$ is nonzero in the Dehn group $\mathbb{R} \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} (\mathbb{R} / 2\pi\mathbb{Z})$, where $[\alpha]$ is the class of $\alpha$ modulo $2\pi$.
nodes.title: Nonvanishing of an edge term in the Dehn group

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
